title: TCL 55P638 (reports "Smart TV", device BeyondTV4), Android TV 11.
notes:
TCL 55P638 (reports "Smart TV", device BeyondTV4), Android TV 11.
Build RP1A.200622.001 release-keys.
Package persistence and CleanYourTV Home verified after reboot on 2026-10-21.
BrowseHere was disabled afterward; the owner confirmed normal TV operation.

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55p638/debloat.txt
Restore: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55p638/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out anything you use.
Disable setupwraith before launcherx; launcher replacement works on this TV.
This list leaves launcherx enabled; launcher/build-and-install.sh handles the Home switch.
Check saved Wi-Fi ownership before disabling setupwraith on another TV.
Google TV home and setup
